AppAgent 开源实现 · 真机验收报告

不做自研 agent 循环：直接运行 CHI 2025 开源的 AppAgent，只改配置 + 两处兼容性小补丁 + 薄封装。

日期 2026-11-10 17:44Pixel 9 Pro XL · Android 16 模型 auto/gpt-6-lunaAppAgent base 2c19004 完成任务 2/8

结论

这一轮把 agent 本体换成了开源实现 TencentQQGYLab/AppAgent （MIT，CHI 2025）。没有重写 planner / executor / action 空间；只把模型地址、模型名、token 上限和轮数上限改成适配本机 magpie 和长任务的值，加了两处设备/模型兼容性小补丁，再用一个 薄封装完成 app 重置、任务喂入、截图/日志归档和最终评测。

严格成功2/8
文本检查通过6/8
VLM 认可2/8
总轮数223
Agent 总耗时2690s
总墙钟3091s
真实截图223

每一步截图都来自 AppAgent 自己保存的 labeled 截图 （runs/appagent/<task>/step_*.png），不是脚本复现；最终判定由外部评测器 拍终屏 + 严格文本检查完成，评测器不属于 AppAgent。两者都过才算成功，因此会出现 “文本检查通过、但 VLM 无法从终屏确认隐藏状态（例如置顶/优先级）”的失败；任务表把两个 检查分开列出，便于判断是 agent 没做，还是证据不可见。

用了哪个开源实现、改了什么

Agent 本体：AppAgent（third_party/AppAgent，base commit 2c19004 + 下表配置/补丁）。它的流程是：ADB 截图 + uiautomator XML → 给可交互元素打编号 → 多模态模型输出 Observation / Thought / Action / Summary → ADB 执行 tap/text/long_press/swipe/grid。我们没有改它的 agent 逻辑。

AppAgent 还自带 exploration → auto_docs 的元素级知识库（这是它原生的 “经验积累”机制，和 RSI/ASPEC 的持久经验思路相近）。本轮为了快速验证，先跑 no-doc 部署模式，没有生成 docs；这属于它的支持模式，但弱于完整的两阶段流程。

为什么不是 Mobile-Agent-v2/E：它们的 Perceptor 依赖 Qwen-VL 图标描述 （DashScope API 或本地 GPU）；当前环境只有 magpie 的 OpenAI-compatible 多模态模型。 AppAgent 只需一个 OpenAI-compatible 视觉模型即可运行，是最小改动路径。

配置差异（仅 config.yaml）

配置项AppAgent 原值本实验值说明
OPENAI_API_BASEhttps://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completionshttp://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions指向本机 magpie
OPENAI_API_KEYsk-magpie本机网关 key
OPENAI_API_MODELgpt-4-vision-previewauto/gpt-6-luna支持截图+文本的模型
MAX_TOKENS300800避免长任务回复被截断
MAX_ROUNDS2040长程任务需要更多轮
REQUEST_INTERVAL101本地网关无需 10s 间隔

原配置备份在 third_party/AppAgent/config.yaml.orig。 除配置外，只新增了 scripts/run_appagent_tasks.py 作为运行/归档/评测的薄封装； 它不参与决策。

仅有的两个代码兼容补丁：

  • scripts/and_controller.py 的 get_xml()： uiautomator dump 返回非零时重试 4 次（每次 1s）。Android 16 在窗口尚未稳定时 会偶发非零退出；不改变 prompt、动作空间或决策逻辑。
  • scripts/model.py 的 parse_explore_rsp()/parse_grid_rsp()： 解析 Action 前去掉 Markdown 反引号/粗体符号（模型偶尔输出 `text("Travel")` 或 **tap(6)**）；只做字符串清洗， 不改变动作词表。

另外薄封装在把设备交给 AppAgent 前会停掉自用的 uiautomator2/ATX instrumentation （显式 kill 设备侧 com.wetest.uia2 的 app_process），避免与 AppAgent 的 adb shell uiautomator dump 冲突；否则 Android 16 上 dump 会返回 137。

失败模式（自动汇总）

  • 长循环：omni_three_notes_edit_archive（10 × tap(7)）；omni_checklist_archive（7 × tap(2)）；omni_tag_search（20 × tap(7)）
  • 文本检查通过、但 VLM 无法从终屏确认：omni_two_notes_pin_delete；omni_checklist_archive；omni_same_title_delete_one；omni_tag_search

AppAgent 在 no-doc 部署模式下运行：没有先跑 exploration 生成文档库。 这是 AppAgent 支持的模式，但比论文中的“先探索再部署”更弱。“最长连续重复动作”只做统计， 用来暴露假进展：连续多次相同动作且界面未变，说明 agent 没有 stall 检测/回退机制。

1. omni_three_notes_edit_archive 失败

App: OmniNotes Rounds: 40 FINISH: 否 AppAgent: 498.9s Total: 529.0s Verifier: False Text check: False

目标：Create three text notes: (1) title Groceries, content Buy milk; (2) title Work, content Finish report; (3) title Travel, content Book train. Then search for Work, open the Work note, replace its content with "Finish report today", go back to the notes list, open the Work note's menu and archive it. Finish on the notes list.

最终判定：Expected visible evidence ['Groceries', 'Travel'] / absent ['Finish report today'] was not confirmed. The navigation drawer is open, so the screen is not finished on the notes list. Only Groceries is visibly listed; Travel is absent, and the screenshot does not show evidence that Work was updated and archived.

注意：连续 10 轮重复 tap(7)，界面没有实质变化。这是 AppAgent 无 stall 检测的表现，可能发生在任务已完成之后（例如无法关闭抽屉），也可能意味着任务根本没推进；请对照逐轮截图判断。

查看某一轮的完整模型请求（AppAgent 原始 prompt，截断）
You are an agent that is trained to perform some basic tasks on a smartphone. You will be given a 
smartphone screenshot. The interactive UI elements on the screenshot are labeled with numeric tags starting from 1. The 
numeric tag of each interactive element is located in the center of the element.

You can call the following functions to control the smartphone:

1. tap(element: int)
This function is used to tap an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be tap(5), which taps the UI element labeled with the number 5.

2. text(text_input: str)
This function is used to insert text input in an input field/box. text_input is the string you want to insert and must 
be wrapped with double quotation marks. A simple use case can be text("Hello, world!"), which inserts the string 
"Hello, world!" into the input area on the smartphone screen. This function is usually callable when you see a keyboard 
showing in the lower half of the screen.

3. long_press(element: int)
This function is used to long press an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be long_press(5), which long presses the UI element labeled with the number 5.

4. swipe(element: int, direction: str, dist: str)
This function is used to swipe an UI element shown on the smartphone screen, usually a scroll view or a slide bar.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen. "direction" is a string that 
represents one of the four directions: up, down, left, right. "direction" must be wrapped with double quotation 
marks. "dist" determines the distance of the swipe and can be one of the three options: short, medium, long. You should 
choose the appropriate distance option according to your need.
A simple use case can be swipe(21, "up", "medium"), which swipes up the UI element labeled with the number 21 for a 
medium distance.

5. grid()
You should call this function when you find the element you want to interact with is not labeled with a numeric tag and 
other elements with numeric tags cannot help with the task. The function will bring up a grid overlay to divide the 
smartphone screen into small areas and this will give you more freedom to choose any part of the screen to tap, long 
press, or swipe.

You are an agent that is trained to perform some basic tasks on a smartphone. You will be given a 
smartphone screenshot. The interactive UI elements on the screenshot are labeled with numeric tags starting from 1. The 
numeric tag of each interactive element is located in the center of the element.

You can call the following functions to control the smartphone:

1. tap(element: int)
This function is used to tap an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be tap(5), which taps the UI element labeled with the number 5.

2. text(text_input: str)
This function is used to insert text input in an input field/box. text_input is the string you want to insert and must 
be wrapped with double quotation marks. A simple use case can be text("Hello, world!"), which inserts the string 
"Hello, world!" into the input area on the smartphone screen. This function is usually callable when you see a keyboard 
showing in the lower half of the screen.

3. long_press(element: int)
This function is used to long press an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be long_press(5), which long presses the UI element labeled with the number 5.

4. swipe(element: int, direction: str, dist: str)
This function is used to swipe an UI element shown on the smartphone screen, usually a scroll view or a slide bar.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen. "direction" is a string that 
represents one of the four directions: up, down, left, right. "direction" must be wrapped with double quotation 
marks. "dist" determines the distance of the swipe and can be one of the three options: short, medium, long. You should 
choose the appropriate distance option according to your need.
A simple use case can be swipe(21, "up", "medium"), which swipes up the UI element labeled with the number 21 for a 
medium distance.

5. grid()
You should call this function when you find the element you want to interact with is not labeled with a numeric tag and 
other elements with numeric tags cannot help with the task. The function will bring up a grid overlay to divide the 
smartphone screen into small areas and this will give you more freedom to choose any part of the screen to tap, long 
press, or swipe.

查看某一轮的完整模型请求（AppAgent 原始 prompt，截断）
You are an agent that is trained to perform some basic tasks on a smartphone. You will be given a 
smartphone screenshot. The interactive UI elements on the screenshot are labeled with numeric tags starting from 1. The 
numeric tag of each interactive element is located in the center of the element.

You can call the following functions to control the smartphone:

1. tap(element: int)
This function is used to tap an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be tap(5), which taps the UI element labeled with the number 5.

2. text(text_input: str)
This function is used to insert text input in an input field/box. text_input is the string you want to insert and must 
be wrapped with double quotation marks. A simple use case can be text("Hello, world!"), which inserts the string 
"Hello, world!" into the input area on the smartphone screen. This function is usually callable when you see a keyboard 
showing in the lower half of the screen.

3. long_press(element: int)
This function is used to long press an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be long_press(5), which long presses the UI element labeled with the number 5.

4. swipe(element: int, direction: str, dist: str)
This function is used to swipe an UI element shown on the smartphone screen, usually a scroll view or a slide bar.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen. "direction" is a string that 
represents one of the four directions: up, down, left, right. "direction" must be wrapped with double quotation 
marks. "dist" determines the distance of the swipe and can be one of the three options: short, medium, long. You should 
choose the appropriate distance option according to your need.
A simple use case can be swipe(21, "up", "medium"), which swipes up the UI element labeled with the number 21 for a 
medium distance.

5. grid()
You should call this function when you find the element you want to interact with is not labeled with a numeric tag and 
other elements with numeric tags cannot help with the task. The function will bring up a grid overlay to divide the 
smartphone screen into small areas and this will give you more freedom to choose any part of the screen to tap, long 
press, or swipe.

查看某一轮的完整模型请求（AppAgent 原始 prompt，截断）
You are an agent that is trained to perform some basic tasks on a smartphone. You will be given a 
smartphone screenshot. The interactive UI elements on the screenshot are labeled with numeric tags starting from 1. The 
numeric tag of each interactive element is located in the center of the element.

You can call the following functions to control the smartphone:

1. tap(element: int)
This function is used to tap an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be tap(5), which taps the UI element labeled with the number 5.

2. text(text_input: str)
This function is used to insert text input in an input field/box. text_input is the string you want to insert and must 
be wrapped with double quotation marks. A simple use case can be text("Hello, world!"), which inserts the string 
"Hello, world!" into the input area on the smartphone screen. This function is usually callable when you see a keyboard 
showing in the lower half of the screen.

3. long_press(element: int)
This function is used to long press an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be long_press(5), which long presses the UI element labeled with the number 5.

4. swipe(element: int, direction: str, dist: str)
This function is used to swipe an UI element shown on the smartphone screen, usually a scroll view or a slide bar.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen. "direction" is a string that 
represents one of the four directions: up, down, left, right. "direction" must be wrapped with double quotation 
marks. "dist" determines the distance of the swipe and can be one of the three options: short, medium, long. You should 
choose the appropriate distance option according to your need.
A simple use case can be swipe(21, "up", "medium"), which swipes up the UI element labeled with the number 21 for a 
medium distance.

5. grid()
You should call this function when you find the element you want to interact with is not labeled with a numeric tag and 
other elements with numeric tags cannot help with the task. The function will bring up a grid overlay to divide the 
smartphone screen into small areas and this will give you more freedom to choose any part of the screen to tap, long 
press, or swipe.

follows: None

You are an agent that is trained to perform some basic tasks on a smartphone. You will be given a 
smartphone screenshot. The interactive UI elements on the screenshot are labeled with numeric tags starting from 1. The 
numeric tag of each interactive element is located in the center of the element.

You can call the following functions to control the smartphone:

1. tap(element: int)
This function is used to tap an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be tap(5), which taps the UI element labeled with the number 5.

2. text(text_input: str)
This function is used to insert text input in an input field/box. text_input is the string you want to insert and must 
be wrapped with double quotation marks. A simple use case can be text("Hello, world!"), which inserts the string 
"Hello, world!" into the input area on the smartphone screen. This function is usually callable when you see a keyboard 
showing in the lower half of the screen.

3. long_press(element: int)
This function is used to long press an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen.
A simple use case can be long_press(5), which long presses the UI element labeled with the number 5.

4. swipe(element: int, direction: str, dist: str)
This function is used to swipe an UI element shown on the smartphone screen, usually a scroll view or a slide bar.
"element" is a numeric tag assigned to an UI element shown on the smartphone screen. "direction" is a string that 
represents one of the four directions: up, down, left, right. "direction" must be wrapped with double quotation 
marks. "dist" determines the distance of the swipe and can be one of the three options: short, medium, long. You should 
choose the appropriate distance option according to your need.
A simple use case can be swipe(21, "up", "medium"), which swipes up the UI element labeled with the number 21 for a 
medium distance.

5. grid()
You should call this function when you find the element you want to interact with is not labeled with a numeric tag and 
other elements with numeric tags cannot help with the task. The function will bring up a grid overlay to divide the 
smartphone screen into small areas and this will give you more freedom to choose any part of the screen to tap, long 
press, or swipe.

相关工作的输入模态

工作年份/venue输入模态与本题相关点
ProphetAgentFSE 2025UI 页面信息 + 事件区域截图 → GPT-4oCUTG + 自然语言测试用例；文本+视觉混合
FuncDroidISSTA 2026FFG + MLLM + 实时截图恢复功能间 flow；截图用于执行与 oracle
ScenGen2025/2026截图 + CV/OCR + 多模态 LLMObserver/Supervisor；每步记录截图路径
DroidAgent2023/2024widget/UI 表示 + 长短期记忆偏文本；没有强调视觉
AppAgent（本报告）CHI 2025 / 开源截图 + labeled UI 元素 + GPT-4VAndroid 真机；tap/text/swipe/grid
Mobile-Agent-v2NeurIPS 2024 / 开源截图 + Qwen-VL 图标描述多 agent 长程导航；需要 Qwen-VL 感知器
Mobile-Agent-E2025 / 开源截图 + Qwen-VL 图标描述self-evolving 经验记忆；perceptor 依赖 Qwen-VL

结论：最近的相关工作大多已经使用截图/多模态；DroidAgent 偏 widget/文本。 我们之前纯文本 UI 树的 FCG 方案确实落后，这也是这次换成开源截图 agent 的原因。

与旧 FCG 方案的直接对比

四卡任务：create → search → open → share旧 FCG 方案（内部）AppAgent（本报告）
设计结构功能卡 + 图 + 绑定器 + 编译器 + postcondition开源 AppAgent：截图 + 元素标注 + ReAct
动作/轮数11 个编译动作见任务表
LLM 调用11每轮 1 次，见任务表
耗时688.8s 规划 + 105.7s 执行见任务表
经验来源手工函数卡本轮为 no-doc 部署；未跑 AppAgent 的 exploration 文档

旧方案数据来自 runs/real/pilot_complex_flow.jsonl； AppAgent 数据来自本报告任务表。两者都在同一台真机上完成，但输入/知识来源不同， 不是严格消融。

局限

  • AppAgent 的部署模式没有独立 planner / verifier / 跨任务经验记忆；长任务主要靠 上一轮 Summary 维持上下文。没有 stall 检测：如果某个点击不生效，模型可能 连续多轮重复同一动作直到 MAX_ROUNDS（结果表中的“最长连续重复动作”列即为此）。
  • 本轮是 no-doc 模式，没有跑 AppAgent 的 exploration 文档库，因此弱于论文完整流程。
  • 动作空间只有 tap / text / long_press / swipe / grid，没有显式 back/home；任务中通过点击 可见返回箭头完成返回。
  • adb shell input text 只适合 ASCII；本轮输入均为英文，中文输入未验证。
  • 任务集只有 8 个，且主要是 OmniNotes；这是 idea 验证，不是完整 benchmark。
  • 还没有把 ProphetAgent / FuncDroid / ScenGen 放在同一任务集上做对照。
  • 最终判定依赖外部 VLM 评测器 + 文本检查；隐藏状态（例如“已归档”本身）只能从终屏推断。

复现

# 1. 还原 AppAgent 原配置，再按上表改 config.yaml
cd third_party/AppAgent
cp config.yaml.orig config.yaml

# 2. 运行全部任务（薄封装：重置 app、喂任务、归档截图、最终评测）
cd ../..
python scripts/run_appagent_tasks.py \
  --tasks benchmark/agent_tasks.yaml \
  --out runs/appagent

# 3. 重新生成报告
python scripts/build_appagent_report.py

证据目录：runs/appagent/<task>/（result.json、steps.json、 appagent_log.jsonl、step_*.png、final.jpg）；AppAgent 原始目录： third_party/AppAgent/tasks/task_<id>_*。完整改动 diff： runs/appagent/appagent_code.diff。
